title: Select T3 assurance and T4 certification requirements
objective: Deterministically select deep-assurance and exact-head certification requirements from T2 residual impacts, certification-sensitive impacts and active AWU risk without executing scanners or full suites.
non_goals: execute CodeQL Semgrep Bandit actionlint zizmor or other security scanners
execute mutation testing or full regression

required_invariants: selector consumes T2 results and active AWU risk without reclassifying Git paths
T3 and T4 requirements are symbolic ids only and never executable commands
R3 always requires T4 exact-head certification
certification-sensitive provenance impact always requires T4 exact-head certification
workflow security static-analysis unknown and human-review residual impacts require T3
documentation-only low-risk work requires neither T3 nor T4
selection never claims assurance or certification has been executed
acceptance_criteria: ACTIONS_SECURITY and WORKFLOW_SYNTAX select workflow assurance at T3 but not T4 for R1
SECURITY_STATIC_ANALYSIS or SECRET_CONTROLS select security assurance at T3
STATIC_ANALYSIS selects static-analysis assurance at T3
CONSERVATIVE_BROAD_IMPACT or HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED selects manual/deep review at T3
R3 selects exact-head certification at T4 even with no residual impact
EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE in T2-covered impacts selects exact-head provenance certification at T4
R0/R1 with no residual or certification-sensitive impact selects no T3/T4

done_when: deep assurance requirements are selected deterministically from residual impact
R3 and provenance-sensitive work cannot bypass T4
low-risk fully covered work avoids unnecessary T3/T4
selection remains execution-free zero-cost and auditable
